# XDR Fixtures

Base64-encoded XDR blobs for every type the StellarGrapher decoder supports.

## Provenance

Fixtures were generated from real Stellar Testnet data or programmatically via
`@stellar/stellar-sdk`'s XDR builder. Each file documents its source.

Programmatic fixtures can be regenerated by running:

```bash
cd frontend
npx tsx scripts/generate-xdr-fixtures.ts
```

> **Note:** Fixtures from Testnet carry the transaction hash and ledger they were
> captured from. Do not regenerate those from code — capture a fresh one instead.

## Adding a fixture

1. Capture or generate the XDR bytes.
2. Encode to base64: `echo -n "$XDR_HEX" | xxd -r -p | base64 -w0 > my-type.b64`.
3. Add a row to the table above with the type and source.
4. Add a test case that imports and decodes it.
